caption:
Your Instagram DMs are leads. Most owners let them sit until after the job.

Instagram ships six free response tools for business accounts: FAQs, Saved Replies, Instant Reply, Away Message, Custom Keywords, and Comment to Message.

Turn on three this week:

1. Instant Reply fires the moment someone messages you
2. Saved Replies give one-tap answers for price, hours, and booking
3. Away Message sets a real reply window so no one assumes you're ignored

That covers Instagram. Your phone, texts, and missed calls need the same speed check.

The free Lead Response Audit scores it.

DM TOOLS.

#ServiceBusiness #SpeedToLead #LocalBusinessMarketing #InstagramForBusiness #LeadFollowUp
rationale: Instagram's native DM tools are a genuinely unclaimed speed-to-lead channel for this account, taught as a concrete this-week setup and bridged to the free audit tool.
